import pandas as pd
p = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/076c8171-9b3b-49b9-a477-244d2a532826.xlsx"
df = pd.read_excel(p, header=1)
# Drop rows without numeric Revenue/Rent
clean = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue","Rent"]).copy()
# Remove section header rows like 'Zone 2'
clean = clean[~clean["Name"].astype(str).str.startswith("Zone")].copy()
clean["rev_to_rent"] = clean["Revenue"] / clean["Rent"]
res = clean.sort_values("rev_to_rent", ascending=True)[["Name","Type","Revenue","Rent","rev_to_rent"]]
print(res.head(10).to_string(index=False))
